faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Hyderabad Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The last date to apply for the Junior Research Fellow position at IIT Hyderabad is 25 August 2026. Ensure your application is submitted via email before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates should have an M.Sc. in Physics or a B.Tech in Engineering Physics from recognized institutes with at least 60% marks, along with a GATE score or equivalent fellowship.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 37,000 plus 27% House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to send your resume and required documents to the official email address specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q5. Is there an application fee for this position?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selection process involves merit-based shortlisting of candidates followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Junior Research Fellow position is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q8. Where is IIT Hyderabad located?
faq.answer: IIT Hyderabad is located in Hyderabad, Telangana.

faq.question: Q9. Does IIT Hyderabad provide age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Information regarding age relaxation is not explicitly detailed in the provided data. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for specific details.

faq.question: Q10. What programming skills are preferred for this role?
faq.answer: Strong interest in programming with experience in PDE/ODE solvers using Python, C/C++, Fortran, or MATLAB is preferred.
